vendors.edge_case: Clean control case: fills the buyer's template exactly, all 30 lines in INR.
Own layout: items grouped by the vendor's categories, not the RFx line numbers; prices quoted GST-inclusive.
A 4% early-payment rebate that changes every price is disclosed only in a numbered note on a later page.
Casual email: four laptop tiers collapsed into one 'average' price, six lines skipped.
Phone photo of a tilted printed rate card: priced in USD, cable locks quoted per box of 10, four lines missing.
